text:
```yaml
name: Stale Issues and Pull Requests

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * *' # Daily at 1:00 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run stale bot
        uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          days-before-stale: 90
          days-before-close: 60
          ignore-issue-updates: true
          ignore-pr-updates: true
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-label: stale
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it hasn't had any recent activity. If you think it should still be open, please leave a comment or reassign it. Thank you!
          close-issue-label: closed
          close-issue-message: |
            This issue has been closed because it hasn't had any recent activity. If you think it should still be open, please reopen it and provide more information. Thank you!
```
